auth.signInToAccount: Sign in to your Quarc account
auth.tagline: Read it. Mark it up. Keep it with you.
auth.taglineBody: A PDF reader for the way you really read: pencil in the margins, highlights that stay, and your place saved on every device.
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

canvas.recentEmpty: The colours you use will be listed here.
canvas.pickFromScreen: Pick a colour from the screen
canvas.shapeSnapHint: Hold the pen still at the end of a stroke to turn it into a clean line, circle, rectangle or other shape
canvas.fingerDraws: Finger draws — tap to make it scroll instead
canvas.fingerScrolls: Finger scrolls — tap to make it draw instead

reader.notFound: This document is not in your library.
reader.notYours: This document belongs to another account.

error.missing: The file for this document is not on this device any more.
error.not-ready: The file has not finished uploading from your other device yet. Try again in a moment.
error.offline: This document is not downloaded to this device and you are offline. Connect to your server to read it.
error.password: This PDF is password-protected, which Quarc Reader does not support yet.
error.invalid: This file could not be opened as a PDF.
error.invalid-local: The copy of this file kept on this device is damaged, or is not a PDF.
error.signin: Your sign-in has expired, so the server will not send this file. Sign in again to read it.
error.gone: The server does not have this file. It may still be uploading from your other device, or it was removed from the server.
error.server: Your server had a problem sending this file. Try again in a moment.
error.network: The server could not be reached. Check that Tailscale is connected, then try again.
error.unknown: This document could not be opened.
error.engine: The PDF engine could not be loaded from the server, so no PDF can be shown. Reload the page (Ctrl+F5); if it keeps happening, the app on the server needs updating.

reader.snapTextHint: A highlighter stroke over text becomes a real text highlight (searchable, listed in your notes, exported as a PDF highlight). Off: it stays freehand ink.
reader.noHighlights: Nothing highlighted yet. Select text and pick a colour, or swipe the highlighter over it.
reader.deleteNotePageConfirm: Delete this note page and everything written on it?
reader.modeHint: Only for this reading. Set your usual style in Settings.
reader.cutHint: Cut: draw around ink to select it, then move, copy or delete it.

readingStyle.title: How do you want to read this?
readingStyle.rememberHint: Don’t ask again. You can change this in Settings.

scroll.title: Scroll
scroll.body: One long page you scroll through, like the web.

book.title: Book
book.body: One page at a time. Swipe or tap the edge to turn it.

empty.all: Your library is empty. Add a PDF to start reading, highlighting and writing in the margins.
empty.local: Nothing is kept on this device only.

library.onlyPdf: Only PDF files can be added.
library.openFailed: That file could not be opened from the other app.
library.openFailed_other: {{count}} files could not be opened from the other app.

importError.password: “{{name}}” is password-protected, which is not supported yet.
importError.invalid: “{{name}}” could not be read as a PDF.
importError.engine: The PDF engine could not be loaded from the server, so “{{name}}” could not be read. Reload the page (Ctrl+F5); if it keeps happening, the app on the server needs updating.

library.syncedHint: Synced with your server: available on all your devices
library.localHint: Only on this device: never uploaded
library.downloadFailed: The download failed. Check your connection.
library.deleteForeverCloud: “{{title}}” will be deleted from this device, from your server and from your other devices, together with its highlights, notes and drawings. This cannot be undone.
library.deleteForeverLocal: “{{title}}” will be deleted from this device, together with its highlights, notes and drawings. It is not synced anywhere, so this cannot be undone.

import.title: Add {{count}} PDF
import.question: Where should this document live?

local.title: Keep on this device only
local.body: Never uploaded and never synced. Only you, only here. Highlights and notes stay on this device too.

cloud.title: Sync with my server
cloud.body: Uploaded to your Quarc server. Reading position, highlights, notes and drawings follow you to every device, and you can share links.

import.remember: Remember my choice for new PDFs
import.changeLater: You can change this for any document later, and the default in Settings.

syncMode.on1: The PDF is uploaded to your Quarc server.
syncMode.on2: Highlights, notes, drawings, bookmarks and your reading position sync across your devices.
syncMode.on3: You will be able to share it with a link. You can stop syncing again at any time.
syncMode.off1: The document is removed from your server and from your other devices.
syncMode.off2: This device keeps the PDF and everything you wrote on it, but it is no longer backed up or synced.
syncMode.off3: Any share links to it stop working.
syncMode.nowLocal: “{{title}}” is now kept on this device only.
syncMode.fetching: Downloading the file to this device first… {{pct}}%

share.title: Share a link
share.explain: Anyone with the link who can reach your server (over Tailscale) can read “{{title}}”. They do not need an account, and they cannot change anything.
share.includeAnnotations: Include my highlights, notes and drawings
share.includeHint: Off: they see the plain PDF. On: they also see everything you added.
share.notUploaded: The file has not finished uploading yet. Try again in a moment.
share.tailscaleNote: Links only work for devices that can reach your server, i.e. on your Tailscale network.

shared.unavailable: This link was not found, has expired or was turned off.

snip.title: Snip: copy or save part of a page
snip.hint: Drag on a page to choose an area
snip.copied: Image copied. Paste it with Ctrl+V.
snip.noText: There is no text in this area.
snip.copyFailed: This device does not let the app copy pictures. Use Save image instead.
snip.copyFallback: Copying pictures is not available here: the share sheet opened instead.
snip.failed: The picture could not be made.

find.title: Find in document
find.noTextHint: This PDF has no text to search (it may be a scan).

export.title: Save PDF
export.explain: Your highlights, notes and drawings stay editable in Quarc. Saving makes an ordinary PDF with them in it — ink as sharp vector lines, highlights as real PDF highlights — that opens anywhere.

copy.title: Save a copy
copy.body: A new PDF with your annotations. The document in your library is not changed.

replace.title: Replace the original in my library
replace.body: Your annotations are written into the document itself.
replace.warning: The document in your library becomes the annotated PDF, and the ink, highlights and notes are no longer editable here — they are part of the pages. The previous version is kept so you can revert. (This does not change the file you originally imported from your device.)

revert.title: Revert to the original
revert.body: Go back to the document as it was before it was replaced. Annotations already written into the file are not editable again.

export.replaced: The document in your library now includes your annotations.

settings.sharedLogin: The same account as every Quarc app
settings.syncChoiceHint: What to do when you add a PDF
settings.autoCache: Keep synced PDFs on this device

settings.storageDeviceHint: {{count}} document(s) are kept on this device only

settings.paperDefaultHint: The colour of the page for documents you have not changed
settings.pageTurnHint: How a page is turned in book mode
settings.keepAwake: Keep the screen on while reading
settings.keepAwakeHint: While a document is open the screen does not dim or lock by itself. Uses a little more battery.
settings.fingerHint: Auto: the finger draws until a stylus is used on this device, then it scrolls
settings.clearDeviceHint: Removes downloaded PDFs and everything stored here
settings.clearConfirm: This removes every PDF and annotation stored on this device. Documents that are synced stay on your server and come back when you sign in again.
settings.clearLocalWarning: {{count}} document(s) are kept on this device only — they will be gone for good.
